J-Curve Technologies is tagged as a data center in Maricopa County, Arizona on OpenStreetMap, but the operator, published power capacity, and business registration could not be confirmed. The address at 2005 West 14th Street in Tempe matches no operator website or news coverage in available search results. No specifications for IT load, cooling capacity, grid connection, or planned expansion are published.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities and 512 MW of published capacity across four operators with disclosed specifications. J-Curve Technologies ranks fifth by published megawatts in the state context, but this ranking reflects only the four facilities with published figures; the ranking assigns no capacity figure to this site, making the rank notation a data artifact rather than a meaningful position.
